$comment: What this build changed this round, shown to the judge by src/round-notes.ts. Overwrite every round: your round number and 4-5 one-liners. npm run check validates the shape.
notes: The forest opens into a flooded cyan Moonwell with reeds, reflections, and open water; ?level=4 jumps there for judging
Three visible cross-currents push the wisp off course - movement behaves differently beyond the trees
Press near a moonstone to still its current, wash away a shadow, raise a different drowned ruin, and anchor your return there
Each raised ruin lights a carrying causeway toward the next objective; the beacon needs fourteen lights and all three spends
The awakened moonstones return in the ending and converge into dawn, paying off all four places
